light_grid

```{r}
update_light <- function(d) {
  d |>
    adjacent_join(diagonal = TRUE) |>
    summarise(on_neighbor = sum(value2), .by = c(row, value, col)) |>
    mutate(
      new_value = case_when(
        value == 1 & (on_neighbor == 2 | on_neighbor == 3) ~ 1,
        value == 1 ~ 0,
        value == 0 & on_neighbor == 3 ~ 1,
        value == 0 ~ 0,
        .unmatched = "error"
      )
    ) |>
    select(-on_neighbor) |>
    right_join(d, by = join_by(row, value, col)) |>
    mutate(value = new_value) |>
    select(-new_value)
}


cycles <- 0

res <- vector(mode = "list", length = 100L)

while (cycles <= 100) {
  if (cycles %% 10 == 0) {
    message(paste(
      "cycle",
      cycles,
      summarise(light_grid, s = sum(value)) |>
        pull(s)
    ))
  }
  res[[cycles + 1]] <- light_grid
  light_grid <- update_light(light_grid)
  cycles <- cycles + 1
}
```

## Part 2

Corners always on



```{r}
turn_on_corners <- function(d) {
  d |>
    mutate(
      value = replace_when(
        value,
        row == 1 & col == 1 ~ 1,
        row == 1 & col == max(col) ~ 1,
        row == max(row) & col == 1 ~ 1,
        row == max(row) & col == max(col) ~ 1,
      )
    )
}

cycles <- 0

res2 <- vector(mode = "list", length = 100L)

while (cycles <= 100) {
  light_grid <- turn_on_corners(light_grid)
  if (cycles %% 10 == 0) {
    message(paste(
      "cycle",
      cycles,
      summarise(light_grid, s = sum(value)) |>
        pull(s)
    ))
  }
  res2[[cycles + 1]] <- light_grid
  light_grid <- update_light(light_grid)
  cycles <- cycles + 1
}


```
